mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is a negative predictor of S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days, with the current level of 3.88% predicting negative returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS level is above 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 325, it signals high inflation, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 325.

mechanism_narrative: The product of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is a negative predictor of S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days, with higher product values predicting negative returns.
failure_condition: The product of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL shows a positive correlation with 20d forward returns (Rank IC > 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (defined by FEDFUNDS > 3.5% and rising), S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days are negative.
failure_condition: In more than 60% of monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 3.5 and rising), SPX produces positive 20d returns.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200, it signals weak demand, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days as the market anticipates policy easing.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1200.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it signals a supply shock, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days as the market prices in a policy response.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) below 700000 predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days, as it signals a severe demand contraction that triggers policy easing.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1200 and RSAFS < 700000.
